The test image and reference images are a near-perfect match. Both show soybean seeds with characteristic pink-to-purple blotches on otherwise yellow/tan seed coats, with discoloration concentrated around and extending from the hilum area — exactly matching Purple_Seed_Stain caused by *Cercospora kikuchii*.
